display_description.zh-CN: 通过对话创建可复用技能，整理说明、脚本和参考资料，并导出技能包。
display_description.en-US: Create reusable skills through conversation, organize instructions and resources, and export a skill package.

display_description.zh-CN: 通过对话设置定时或周期任务，安排提醒、巡检和报告。
display_description.en-US: Set up scheduled or recurring tasks, reminders, checks, and reports through conversation.

display_description.zh-CN: 根据描述生成图片，或对已有图片进行编辑、合成和风格调整。
display_description.en-US: Generate images from descriptions, or edit, combine, and restyle existing images.

display_description.zh-CN: 从主题或脚本制作口播短视频，完成分镜、生成、检查、字幕和合成。
display_description.en-US: Turn a topic or script into a spoken video, including shot planning, generation, checks, subtitles, and composition.

display_description.zh-CN: 通过云桌面中的抖音创作者中心发布视频，使用当前账号的登录状态。
display_description.en-US: Publish videos through Douyin Creator Center on the cloud desktop using the current account login.

display_description.zh-CN: 通过抖音开放平台扫码投稿，作为桌面发布不可用时的备用方式，也可管理开放平台授权。
display_description.en-US: Publish through the Douyin Open Platform QR flow as a fallback for desktop publishing, and manage Open Platform authorization.

display_description.zh-CN: 按授权的营销计划选择热点、制作视频、发布到抖音并汇总结果。
display_description.en-US: Follow an authorized marketing plan to select trends, produce videos, publish to Douyin, and report results.

display_description.zh-CN: 访问网页、填写表单、截图和提取页面信息，也可执行网站测试和浏览器自动化。
display_description.en-US: Navigate websites, fill forms, capture screenshots, extract page data, and run browser workflows and website tests.
